scope_note: Authored evaluator rubric grounded in problem sources. Upstream testpoints are evaluator-side comparison references, not candidate input. Review obligations are not an exhaustive requirement set or coverage-bin denominator.

coverage_policy.meaning: Functional coverage of a reviewed, versioned applicable-bin inventory; code coverage reported separately.
coverage_policy.denominator_rule: Freeze applicable bins and reviewed exclusions before closure. File counts, rubric completion and Python behavioral tests do not establish SystemVerilog/UVM simulation coverage.

obligations.requirement: Predict each segment's direction, lane speed, CSID, byte count and CSAAT-driven chip-select sequence from commands; compare serial pins and received bytes.
checks: Predict each segment's direction, lane speed, CSID, byte count and CSAAT-driven chip-select sequence from commands; compare serial pins and received bytes.
negative_tests: Invalid CSID and dual/quad bidirectional commands must produce specified errors.

obligations.requirement: Measure SCK and sample edges for every CPOL/CPHA combination, full-cycle setting and resolved divider/CS timing configuration.
checks: Measure SCK and sample edges for every CPOL/CPHA combination, full-cycle setting and resolved divider/CS timing configuration.
negative_tests: Change configuration between queued segments and check mandatory idle delays.

obligations.requirement: Predict transmitted byte order and received word byte enables for aligned and partial words in both ByteOrder configurations.
checks: Predict transmitted byte order and received word byte enables for aligned and partial words in both ByteOrder configurations.
negative_tests: Use lengths around word boundaries and forbidden zero-byte TX writes.

obligations.requirement: Exhaust TX or fill RX during transfer; refill/drain and check no missing/duplicate bytes and correct retained CS.
checks: Exhaust TX or fill RX during transfer; refill/drain and check no missing/duplicate bytes and correct retained CS.
negative_tests: Delay service for multiple serial periods and stall at a segment boundary.

obligations.requirement: Check documented FIFO/command/pin reset behavior and ability to start a clean transaction after software reset.
checks: Check documented FIFO/command/pin reset behavior and ability to start a clean transaction after software reset.
negative_tests: Reset during a transfer, stall or passthrough transition.

obligations.requirement: Check event/error enables, status/clear effects and interrupts with an independently logged event stream.
checks: Check event/error enables, status/clear effects and interrupts with an independently logged event stream.
negative_tests: Clear status concurrently with new event; command while READY is low.

obligations.requirement: Compare passthrough requests and returned data with physical flash-side pins, output enables and ownership.
checks: Compare passthrough requests and returned data with physical flash-side pins, output enables and ownership.
negative_tests: Overlap host work and passthrough transition; enforce the documented ownership constraints.

obligations.requirement: Exercise command slots and compare decoded opcode/address/dummy/payload phases and lane widths against programmed command metadata.
checks: Exercise command slots and compare decoded opcode/address/dummy/payload phases and lane widths against programmed command metadata.
negative_tests: Shortest permitted inactive CS spacing and unsupported command encodings.

obligations.requirement: Independently predict flash status, busy/WEL and software update effects before and after serial commands.
checks: Independently predict flash status, busy/WEL and software update effects before and after serial commands.
negative_tests: Race software status changes against serial status reads.

obligations.requirement: Compare complete configured JEDEC bytes and SFDP discovery reads at address/length boundaries.
checks: Compare complete configured JEDEC bytes and SFDP discovery reads at address/length boundaries.
negative_tests: Abort reads and read beyond configured ranges using explicitly specified expected behavior.

obligations.requirement: Use independent memory contents to predict pipelined reads, dummy cycles, mailbox transitions and 3B/4B addresses.
checks: Use independent memory contents to predict pipelined reads, dummy cycles, mailbox transitions and 3B/4B addresses.
negative_tests: Cross mailbox/read-buffer boundaries while software updates buffers.

obligations.requirement: Track opcode/address/payload entries and ordering from observed serial commands to software-visible upload FIFOs.
checks: Track opcode/address/payload entries and ordering from observed serial commands to software-visible upload FIFOs.
negative_tests: Fill upload storage and abort commands; no fictitious completed upload.

obligations.requirement: Predict command filtering, address/payload transformations and locally intercepted responses before downstream transmission.
checks: Predict command filtering, address/payload transformations and locally intercepted responses before downstream transmission.
negative_tests: Filtered writes must cause no downstream side effect; test mask and mailbox boundaries.

obligations.requirement: Check TPM framing, read/write bytes, readiness behavior and hardware-return registers against an independent model.
checks: Check TPM framing, read/write bytes, readiness behavior and hardware-return registers against an independent model.
negative_tests: Mix TPM and flash/passthrough with minimum inactive CS spacing.

obligations.requirement: Predict SETUP/OUT/IN token/data/handshake sequences, address/endpoint qualification and data toggle transitions.
checks: Predict SETUP/OUT/IN token/data/handshake sequences, address/endpoint qualification and data toggle transitions.
negative_tests: Repeated tokens, wrong addresses and invalid toggles follow specified reject/retry behavior.

obligations.requirement: Track unique buffer ownership from software availability to receive FIFO metadata and reclamation; compare payload/length.
checks: Track unique buffer ownership from software availability to receive FIFO metadata and reclamation; compare payload/length.
negative_tests: Exhaust available buffers and fill RX FIFO; no overwrite or false packet completion.

obligations.requirement: Compare IN bytes, length and completion metadata including zero/minimum/maximum packet boundaries.
checks: Compare IN bytes, length and completion metadata including zero/minimum/maximum packet boundaries.
negative_tests: Retries, STALL, isochronous mode and interrupted transfers must not create false completion.

obligations.requirement: Independently decode received USB data and validate accepted payload and metadata.
checks: Independently decode received USB data and validate accepted payload and metadata.
negative_tests: Inject bad CRC/PID/bit stuffing and malformed lengths; reject corrupted completions.

obligations.requirement: Drive connect/reset/suspend/resume timing and check link state, bus behavior and interrupts.
checks: Drive connect/reset/suspend/resume timing and check link state, bus behavior and interrupts.
negative_tests: Resume/reset at suspend boundary and lose VBUS/sense while active.

obligations.requirement: Exercise supported PHY pin/bus settings and compare transmit/receive decoding in the corresponding digital PHY model.
checks: Exercise supported PHY pin/bus settings and compare transmit/receive decoding in the corresponding digital PHY model.
negative_tests: Constrain or explicitly reject unsupported configuration combinations.

obligations.requirement: Check suspend request, wake-detection-active and wake-acknowledge ordering while USB functional clocks stop/restart.
checks: Check suspend request, wake-detection-active and wake-acknowledge ordering while USB functional clocks stop/restart.
negative_tests: Inject resume, reset or sense loss during handoff and require retained wake event.

obligations.requirement: Run an external host transaction through SPI_DEVICE and SPI_HOST0 to a flash model; compare both interfaces and resulting memory effects.
checks: Run an external host transaction through SPI_DEVICE and SPI_HOST0 to a flash model; compare both interfaces and resulting memory effects.
negative_tests: Filter/translate the command and reset one side during active passthrough; use an explicitly versioned recovery contract.

obligations.requirement: Integrate the actual USB wake interface with a controllable pinmux/AON boundary model and verify wake completion after clock removal.
checks: Integrate the actual USB wake interface with a controllable pinmux/AON boundary model and verify wake completion after clock removal.
negative_tests: A stimulus-only pulse is insufficient: check request/active/acknowledge ordering and absence of lost wake.

obligations.requirement: Implement the declared TL-UL subset and software-visible peripheral isolation.
checks: Use an active TL-UL agent, independent request/response scoreboard and backpressure; interleave accesses to all selected modules.
negative_tests: Malformed requests require specified errors; do not invent integrity encoding from an incomplete source.

obligations.requirement: Derive all selected CSR reset values, access semantics, locks, valid fields and side effects from the supplied register specifications and HJSON.
checks: Create UVM RAL and independent frontdoor register checks for every included module, including reset and lock sequencing.
negative_tests: Illegal widths/masks/addresses and locked writes must have explicit specified results.

source_conflicts.issue: The locked README leaves the Bus Integrity Scheme unfilled and contains historical planned-behavior statements. The input does not fully define integrity encoding and fault acceptance.
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Apply the revised question's CT-01, D-02; retain their checker obligations and any precise local gate. Do not reopen settled prose contradictions or silently copy golden RTL.

source_conflicts.issue: The theory COMMAND table says LEN is 8 bits (0:255); the register definition says 9 bits.
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Apply the revised question's SH-05; retain their checker obligations and any precise local gate. Do not reopen settled prose contradictions or silently copy golden RTL.

source_conflicts.issue: README describes separate core clock; the interface and selected top configuration expose one clk_i.
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Explicitly bind this profile to the locked declared interface; do not invent another port or silently infer it from RTL.

source_conflicts.issue: The theory SCK-period and timeslice equations divide by CLKDIV+1, conflicting with the slower-clock prose, counter description and register formula T(sck)=2*(CLK_DIV+1)*T(core).
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Apply the revised question's SH-03, SH-04; retain their checker obligations and any precise local gate. Do not reopen settled prose contradictions or silently copy golden RTL.

source_refs.anchor_exact: The SPI event interrupt is signaled only when the IP enters the corresponding state.

source_conflicts.issue: Theory describes state-entry-only event interrupts, while read-only/status interrupt register descriptions and event predicates require careful level-versus-event interpretation. The source texts do not provide a single unambiguous temporal oracle.
source_conflicts.required_resolution: Record exact assertion/deassertion and enable-while-condition-active behavior before generating SPI-06 expected interrupts; cover entry, sustained condition, mask changes and repeat entry separately.

reference_gaps: Upstream leaf RTL/DV is not an existing implementation or verification suite for the authored reduced subsystem wrapper.
Selected reference files are not a proved standalone dependency closure; use a full pinned checkout to resolve build dependencies.
No simulation, CDC/lint signoff, formal proof or coverage percentage is certified.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: IDLE uses STATUS.ACTIVE becoming low; READY uses STATUS.READY becoming high. They are distinct event predicates and EVENT_ENABLE fields.
checks: Exercise a command-ready but active transfer, then idle; predict the two predicates separately. Temporal IRQ qualification is a separate contract.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For this exercise RXWM is true exactly when rx_depth_words > RX_WATERMARK. Use this strict comparison for STATUS.RXWM and the RXWM event predicate. The author selects the explicit greater-than event definition to adjudicate the conflicting reaches wording inside HJSON; this is not blanket HJSON precedence.
checks: Check threshold-1, threshold and threshold+1 in FIFO words, including threshold zero and masking. Freeze that oracle before running the DUT.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: During unstalled clock generation T_SCK = 2*(CLKDIV+1)*T_core and T_half_SCK = (CLKDIV+1)*T_core. Interpret waveform time units using this half-period.
checks: Measure complete and half periods for CLKDIV=0,1 and a larger value; distinguish intentional stalls from divider timing.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: A running divider timeslice spans CLKDIV+1 core cycles: T_timeslice=(CLKDIV+1)*T_core. FSM updates remain subject to the documented enable/stall conditions.
checks: Check divider reload/countdown and frozen state under a stall; relate unstalled slices to SH-03 half periods.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: COMMAND.LEN is bits [8:0], range 0..511. A data segment transfers LEN+1 bytes; a dummy segment uses LEN+1 dummy cycles as defined by the field.
checks: Cover encoded LEN=0,255,256,511, pack all nine bits and check exactly 1..512 units for the applicable direction.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Quad transfer emits the upper nibble [7:4], followed by [3:0], with the source-defined SD lane ordering.
checks: Use bytes whose nibbles and all bit positions differ; reconstruct exactly eight bits per byte.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Dual output consumes [7:6], [5:4], [3:2], [1:0] in order for each byte. Each shift consumes exactly two bits.
checks: Reconstruct asymmetric walking-one byte patterns in dual mode and verify no bit duplication or omission.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: TXSTALL/RXSTALL are diagnostic states and do not directly create an event IRQ. Independently evaluate the declared FIFO and other event-enable predicates.
checks: Induce TX and RX stalls with event enables cleared and enabled individually; separate associated FIFO events from the diagnostic flags.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The author adopts the coherent four-byte PAYLOAD_SWAP_MASK/PAYLOAD_SWAP_DATA contract: payload_swap_en enables masked substitution in the first four eligible payload bytes. Unselected bits and later bytes pass through unchanged; shorter payloads only transform bytes actually present. Preserve the documented byte ordering.
checks: Check payload lengths 0,1,3,4,5, distinct mask/data bytes, all-zero and all-one masks, and disabled swap.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: CMD_INFO.addr_mode refers to ADDR_MODE.addr_4b_en for the configured address-width choice. Bind the actual declared enum values and ADDR_MODE CSR.
checks: Cover no-address, configured address and explicitly selected address-width modes using the declared encoding.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The declared field is CMD_INFO.read_pipeline_mode[23:22]. Preserve its multi-value enumeration and per-mode timing contract.
checks: Generate the register model from the two-bit field; exercise every declared mode and handle reserved values explicitly.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Upload address presence and width follow the current CMD_INFO.addr_mode enum and ADDR_MODE.addr_4b_en where that enum selects the global width. Upload only the address bytes present in the decoded command.
checks: For each address mode, independently compare uploaded opcode, address and payload boundaries, including address-free commands.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Ingress is 112 32-bit words (448 bytes): payload offset/depth 0/64, command 64/16, address 80/16, TPM-write 96/16, all in words. Egress is 848 words: read buffer 0/512, mailbox 512/256, SFDP 768/64, TPM-read 832/16. Banks have independent address spaces.
checks: Convert words to bytes explicitly; check every first/last address, no intra-bank overlap and correct bank routing.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Use the current logical sidebands a_user={instr_type,cmd_intg,data_intg} and d_user={rsp_intg,data_intg}. The old reserved/parity typedef and TL_DUW=4 example are not a fixed-version ABI. D-02 owns the remaining public type/encoding contract; logical request/response planning can continue.
checks: Check field identity in the shared interface contract; require D-02 evidence before byte/bit-level integrity acceptance.
adjudication_obligations.local_gate: Only TL-UL packed interface binding and integrity-oracle acceptance await the D-02 normative type/encoding addendum.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The selected top configuration instantiates uart0..uart3 (four UARTs). UART is whole-chip background and is outside both reduced subsystem DUTs.
checks: Check scope inventory; do not add UART RTL, UART coverage bins or a global execution blocker.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The base pinout has 47 muxed pads: IOA=9, IOB=13, IOC=13, IOR=12; direct IOR8/IOR9 are excluded. A 32-bit GPIO vector is not a count of all MIO pads. This constrains AON PINMUX geometry; it is external context in serial-I/O.
checks: For in-scope PINMUX check enumeration, index bounds and direct/muxed classification; otherwise retain a boundary fact only.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The local ROM-key table enumerates seven slots, 0..6. Treat the earlier three-slot count as obsolete background; ROM/key provisioning is outside these exercises.
checks: Retain the table/count correction in provenance; create no ROM DUT bins or global gate.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: In serial-I/O use the selected SPI_DEVICE CONTROL modes disabled/flashmode/passthrough with TPM controlled separately. Do not add a legacy Firmware mode without a declared interface. In AON this SPI paragraph is out-of-scope background only.
checks: Check selected mode enumeration for serial-I/O; for AON check only that the scope remains the six control IPs.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Author convention: CPHA determines the output launch edge (0 trailing, 1 leading); FULLCYC modifies receive sampling latency only, from half a SCK cycle to one full cycle after the corresponding launch. Preserve CPOL edge polarity. This chooses the field's sampling-only description; it is not a proven upstream implementation property.
checks: Cross CPOL/CPHA/FULLCYC and divider values using an independent edge schedule; verify transmit and receive timing separately.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Chip selects are zero-indexed. For this exercise valid CSID satisfies 0 <= CSID < NumCS; CSID=NumCS is invalid and follows the declared CSIDINVAL error handling.
checks: Test NumCS-1, NumCS and the largest encodable value; handle NumCS=1 and avoid creating an extra chip-select pin.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Require conservation/order of accepted one-byte segments and correct READY/backpressure behavior. Six-versus-seven pipeline examples do not define a universal first-stall cycle: record initial queue/FSM/divider conditions and accepted commands when evaluating that observation.
checks: Exercise bursts around six/seven segments; check no data loss and captured stalls. Keep an exact-first-stall timing claim pending a reviewed pipeline timing contract.
adjudication_obligations.local_gate: Only a cycle-exact first-stall latency bin requires a versioned initial-state/acceptance/pipeline-depth contract.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: For this exercise use the detailed staged/committed contract: SW requests cross via the asynchronous queue; serial Read Status emits atomic bytes from the latest committed state and can observe BUSY changes during one transaction at eight-SPI-clock commit boundaries. Passthrough gating changes only at CSb release using committed BUSY. Do not invent a fixed SW-to-SPI CDC latency.
checks: Poll multiple status bytes while issuing a non-racing SW clear; check byte atomicity and delayed passthrough reopening. Keep simultaneous HW/SW same-bit priority separate.
adjudication_obligations.local_gate: Only simultaneous HW/SW updates to the same status bit await an explicit arbitration rule; serialized updates and byte-boundary polling are specified.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Apply the control-endpoint post-SETUP special case separately from ordinary OUT flow control: after SETUP clears protocol stall, the guide's set_nak_out/rxenable_out conditions hold subsequent IN/OUT requests in NAK until software prepares the control transfer. Do not extend that special condition to every endpoint/transaction.
checks: Separate ordinary OUT backpressure from post-SETUP control IN/OUT tests; check recovery after software configures the new request.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Model synchronous accesses at each SRAM port. For this exercise the functional bus/USB clocks share the documented 48 MHz input; preserve their port/domain identities and the separate wake clock. Clock gating and wake handoff still require explicit CDC/reset analysis. The phrase asynchronous dual-port does not require asynchronous read data or unrelated functional frequencies.
checks: Specify port edges, enables and reset/gating constraints in the shared contract; test buffer ownership and wake transfer when the functional clock stops.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: The current input does not supply a complete normative packed TL-UL type and integrity-code algorithm. Before compatible interface/encoding acceptance, supply a pinned public interface package or explicit reviewed specification addendum covering widths, ordering, encoding and error policy. Keep the logical protocol requirements; CT-01 rejects obsolete ABI examples.
checks: Validate the supplied type/encoding contract on both RTL and UVM sides with known vectors and invalid-code tests before counting integrity bins.
adjudication_obligations.local_gate: TL-UL ABI and integrity encoding/fault bins remain unverified until a normative interface/algorithm addendum is accepted.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Partition USB transfer expectations by subtype. Apply the declared OUT_ISO behavior to isochronous endpoints and ordinary ACK/NAK rules to the ordinary transaction types for which they are specified.
checks: Cross endpoint mode with available-buffer/error conditions and select an independent subtype-aware response oracle.

adjudication_obligations.requirement: Program the declared PHY_CONFIG.tx_use_d_se0 field. The theory name use_tx_d_se0 is an alias in prose for the same transmit encoding selection, not a second field.
checks: Check both DP/DN and D/SE0 output encodings with the actual field and the corresponding pin mapping.
